text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring), where contenders 
vie for the prestigious spring shield. 
Biwa Hayahide watches the race from the 
stands and hears the soaring praise 
surrounding Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian confronts Mejiro McQueen and 
Mihono Bourbon. No matter who stands 
before her, she will simply prove her own 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian trades fierce sparks with the 
two of them. Having declared war, she has 
no intention of losing—
